notablePrerequisites: You control up to five lands that can tap to produce at least {3}{U}.
description:
Activate up to five lands by tapping them, adding at least {3}{U}.
Cast Illusionist's Stratagem by paying {3}{U}, blinking Scholar of the Ages and Peregrine Drake and causing you to draw a card.
When Scholar of the Ages and Peregrine Drake enter the battlefield, their abilities trigger.
Resolve the Scholar of the Ages trigger, returning Illusionist's Stratagem to your hand from your graveyard.
Resolve the Peregrine Drake trigger, untapping up to five lands.
Repeat.
